entities.name: Initial Registration Procedure
entities.description: Procedure performed by UE to register with the network for the first time in a registration area.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message sent by UE to initiate registration procedure.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: Initial state of UE before successful registration with the network.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: State achieved by UE after successful registration with the network.

relations.description: Initial registration procedure begins with UE sending REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
Initial registration procedure requires UE to be in 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state.
Successful completion of initial registration procedure establishes 5GMM-REGISTERED state.
